environment.description: Application deployed on EKS 1.29 with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' profile via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Container runtime is containerd with default seccomp profile applied. The pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1000), and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Volume mounts use a PersistentVolumeClaim mounted exclusively at /app/documents with no other hostPath or additional volume mounts. The node uses a Bottlerocket AMI with SELinux in enforcing mode (MCS labels isolate container filesystem views). Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforces that no container may mount paths outside /app/documents and /tmp.
